tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. The default ground for every section.

tokens.name: bg-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating section background and footer. Sections alternate bg / bg-alt with no divider line between them.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and tiles that sit on bg-alt, popovers and sheets.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Quiet control fills: secondary icon buttons, the segmented-control track, skeletons, tags.

tokens.name: nav-glass
tokens.usage: Translucent navigation bar background; always paired with the blur-glass backdrop filter.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers (1px) inside lists, the nav bottom edge and the footer. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text and headlines. 15:1+ on bg, bg-alt, surface and fill in both themes.

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: Subheads, body copy under a headline, metadata. ≥4.6:1 on bg, bg-alt and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: label-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholder text, disabled labels, legal copy at 24px+ only, and icons. 3.3:1+ on bg and bg-alt (light), 4.1:1 on bg (dark): not for small body text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, selected states, progress. The one saturated colour on most screens.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover fill.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (4.7:1).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and text CTAs ("Learn more ›"). 5.1:1+ on bg, bg-alt, surface in both themes.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Text-field and checkbox borders (1px). 3.3:1+ on bg, bg-alt and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 3px ring with a 1px gap. 4.3:1+ on every ground.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The "New" eyebrow and promotional labels, as text only. 5:1+ on bg, bg-alt, surface in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success / "In stock" text and icons, always with a word or check icon. 4.7:1+ on the grounds in both themes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, always with an icon or message text. 4.9:1+ on bg, bg-alt, surface in both themes.

tokens.name: inverse-bg
tokens.usage: Contrast tiles: a dark product tile in light theme (flips in dark).

tokens.name: inverse-label
tokens.usage: Text on inverse-bg (15:1).

tokens.name: switch-on
tokens.usage: Switch track when on (default green tone). Deepened from the classic iOS green so the track holds 3.3:1 on bg and 3:1 on bg-alt (light); 10:1 on bg (dark).

tokens.name: switch-off
tokens.usage: Switch track when off. Deliberately faint (1.2:1 light, 1.8:1 dark): the off state is carried by the knob's position and shadow-knob; turn on showLabels for an explicit O glyph where contrast matters.

tokens.name: switch-knob
tokens.usage: The switch knob in both themes, lifted by shadow-knob.

tokens.name: segment-track
tokens.usage: Track of the inset (iOS-style) SegmentedControl. Unselected labels in label read 14:1 on it.

tokens.name: segment-thumb
tokens.usage: Selected-segment thumb of the inset SegmentedControl; label text reads 16:1 (light) and 5.5:1 (dark) on it.

families.display: "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro Icons", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.text: "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Icons", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Headlines: semibold, tight leading, slightly negative tracking at large sizes. Centered in hero tiles.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: One per page: the product or page hero. Drop to headline-1 under 734px wide.

styles.name: headline-3
styles.usage: Secondary tiles; headline-1 on small screens.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Page titles in app screens and settings.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Small card titles, list section headers.

styles.name: subhead
styles.sample: Everything you need. Nothing you don't.
styles.usage: The one line under a hero or tile headline, in label-secondary or label.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Body and UI text. 17px is the base; never go below 12px.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Above a headline, in highlight ("New") or label.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Quietly powerful, with every detail in its place.

styles.name: body-emphasis
styles.usage: Inline emphasis, list item titles, prices.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Card body, small buttons, form helper text.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Inset SegmentedControl labels; 600 for the selected segment.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, hairline offsets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked text lines of different styles; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons side by side; list row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap inside cards; form field spacing.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (large).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gutter between tiles is 12px on bg-alt mosaics.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Headline-to-CTA gap in tiles; card padding (large).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero tile top padding; space between content groups.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on small screens.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Section top and bottom padding (default).

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: Hero section padding on large screens.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, small tags, keyboard keys.

tokens.name: radius-control-inner
tokens.usage: Inset SegmentedControl thumb (track radius minus its 2px padding).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, segmented-control thumb, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Inset SegmentedControl track.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Text fields, menus, small cards, images inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and content tiles (the signature radius).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large hero tiles, sheets and modals.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button and the segmented-control track: always fully round ends.

shadow.note: Shadows are rare and soft. Prefer a background change (bg → bg-alt) to separate content.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Default. Most surfaces separate by background colour, not shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on bg-alt. In dark, a faint 1px edge replaces the shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-card-hover
tokens.usage: Card hover; pair with a 1.01 scale over 0.3s.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, sheets and modals.

tokens.name: shadow-knob
tokens.usage: The switch knob.

tokens.name: shadow-segment-thumb
tokens.usage: The selected thumb of the inset SegmentedControl.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: Max width of text and tile grids, centred.

tokens.name: content-width-wide
tokens.usage: Max width of full-bleed media sections.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side margin of the page at every breakpoint below content-width.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Navigation bar height; sticky, under blur-glass.

tokens.name: tile-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles in a mosaic grid.

effects.note: Single CSS values for the glass and easing.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter for nav-glass and translucent sheets.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Easing for hovers, reveals and fades (0.3s; 0.6s for section reveals).

tokens.name: ease-switch
tokens.usage: Switch knob and segment thumb slide (0.25s): a quick ease with a hint of overshoot.
